title: 我的早晨

explanations.1: Number used to state the time of waking up.
explanations.2: Measure word for hours in telling time.
explanations.3: Indicates the sequence of actions after getting up.
explanations.4: Shows the first action in a sequence.
explanations.6: Number used with a measure word to count cups.
explanations.7: Measure word for liquids in a cup.
explanations.8: Common measure word for counting bread.
explanations.9: Indicates the starting point of departure.
explanations.10: Noun specifying the place of departure.
explanations.14: Connects the subject with his friend.
explanations.15: Adverb showing the action is done jointly.

translation: This morning, I got up at six o'clock. After getting up, I first brushed my teeth, then washed my face. I put on clothes and ate breakfast. I drank a cup of milk and ate a piece of bread. Then I left home for school. At school, I studied Chinese and also studied math. At noon, my friend and I ate together in the cafeteria. We ate rice and dishes. In the afternoon, I went home to do homework. In the evening, my mom cooked, and we ate dinner together. After dinner, I watched TV for a while. I went to sleep at ten o'clock.
